items.title: HackGPT: AI-Powered Penetration Testing Platform Includes GPT-4 and Other AI Engines
items.description: HackGPT Enterprise is a new tool made for security teams focuses on being scalable and compliant, meeting the growing need for effective vulnerability assessments. The platform supports multi-model AI, including OpenAI’s GPT-4 and local LLMs like Ollama, enabling pattern recognition, anomaly detection, and zero-day vulnerability discovery. Developed by Yashab Alam, this cloud-native platform…
